'''Economics''' was a science.<ref name="Crucible" /> [[Macroeconomics]]<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref> and [[microeconomics]] were branches of economics,<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> and [[Economist/Legends|economists]] were specialists in economics.<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|business/13314_1.html|Currency Upheavals Deliver Profits to IBC}}</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Economics was first mentioned in the ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'', a [[1989]] supplement written by [[Greg Gorden]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Economics|economics]] is a [[Wikipedia:Social science|science]] that studies the general concepts of [[Wikipedia:Production (economics)|production]], [[Wikipedia:Distribution (economics)|distribution]], and [[Wikipedia:Consumption (economics)|consumption]] of [[Wikipedia:Goods and services|goods and services]].<ref name="Economics">{{WebCite|url=https://www.dictionary.com/browse/economics|text=ECONOMICS Definition & Meaning|work=[[Wikipedia:Dictionary.com|Dictionary.com, LLC]]|archivedate=20241204011848}}</ref>
